# hyperfluid_sql_engine_catalog (Resource)

A catalog of a SQL engine cluster: an Iceberg warehouse, an external database or a demo dataset. Catalogs cannot be changed in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An Iceberg warehouse in a bucket of the environment.
resource "hyperfluid_sql_engine_catalog" "lake" {
  cluster_id  = hyperfluid_sql_engine_cluster.analytics.id
  name        = "lake"
  kind        = "iceberg"
  bucket_name = hyperfluid_bucket.warehouse.name
}

# A managed database, read through one of its viewer users.
resource "hyperfluid_sql_engine_catalog" "orders" {
  cluster_id                 = hyperfluid_sql_engine_cluster.analytics.id
  name                       = "orders"
  kind                       = "postgresql"
  managed_postgresql_user_id = hyperfluid_managed_postgresql_user.reader.id
}

# An external database, reached with a connection bundle stored as a secret.
resource "hyperfluid_sql_engine_catalog" "crm" {
  cluster_id        = hyperfluid_sql_engine_cluster.analytics.id
  name              = "crm"
  kind              = "mysql"
  connection_secret = hyperfluid_secret.crm_connection.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Id of the SQL engine cluster. Changing this forces a new catalog.
- `kind` (String) Connector: `iceberg`, `postgresql`, `mysql`, `mariadb`, `clickhouse`, `tpch`, `tpcds` or `faker`. Changing this forces a new catalog.
- `name` (String) Catalog name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, at most 63. Changing this forces a new catalog.

### Optional

- `bucket_name` (String) Bucket backing the warehouse; `iceberg` only, and required there. Not recovered by import. Changing this forces a new catalog.
- `connection_secret` (String) Organization secret holding the connection bundle; required for `mysql`, `mariadb` and `clickhouse`, or for an external `postgresql`. Not recovered by import. Changing this forces a new catalog.
- `managed_postgresql_user_id` (String) Id of a `viewer` managed PostgreSQL user whose credentials the catalog uses; `postgresql` only. Not recovered by import. Changing this forces a new catalog.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<cluster_id>/<name>`.
- `message` (String) Last message from the platform.
- `phase` (String) Reconcile phase, such as `Ready`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# SQL engine catalog import id is "<cluster_id>/<name>".
terraform import hyperfluid_sql_engine_catalog.lake 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/lake
```
